summary: TriplePoint Venture Growth BDC Corp., a Maryland BDC, furnished an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 announcing a routine quarterly distribution. The board declared a $0.23 per share regular cash distribution, payable December 30, 2026 to holders of record December 16, 2026; a previously disclosed $0.06 supplemental distribution carries the same dates. The company will report third-quarter 2026 results after the November 4 close, followed by a 5:00 p.m. ET call with CEO Labe, President Srivastava and CFO Wilhelms. No advisor, special-situation mechanics or deal terms; no arbitrage angle applies.
